metadata.literal_pointer: PDF page 1: letter dated 'Date:03/08/2026'; subject line naming the six-monthly compliance status report of Environment Clearance of the Raiden Infotech data center project at Turbhe (typed 'Turbe') MIDC, TTC Industrial Area, Navi Mumbai; reference line citing the EC letter number as typed 'SIA/MH/1NFRA2/531703/2025' (digit one in place of the letter I), i.e. proposal SIA/MH/INFRA2/531703/2025; body sentence naming the compliance period December 2025 to March 2026; separate present-tense final body sentence stating that the data center is 'under construction phase'. PDF page 2: closing, company seal and proponent signature block (personal details not recorded).
metadata.visual_review_method: Complete Poppler-rendered pages (110 dpi) reviewed; extracted layout text used as a cross-check.
metadata.independent_recapture: Root recapture on 2026-10-09 is byte-identical to the research lane's 2026-09-26 capture at tmp/research-round42-india-parivesh/raiden-hycr-cover-letter.pdf (same SHA-256 and length). The 2026-10-02 attempts failed at the network layer ('fetch failed') and were not retried under those names.
metadata.document_slot: getAllDocs doc_3 for compliance_report_id 1237477223; doc_1 and doc_2 are N/A; the portal-generated acknowledgement is compliance_report_pdf.
metadata.reporting_period_as_labelled: 01 Jun (01 Oct - 31 Mar), reporting year 2025; the letter itself names December 2025 to March 2026
metadata.date_format_basis: The letter prints 03/08/2026 without stating a format. It is read day-first as 3 August 2026: Indian convention; the PDF's own creation timestamp 2026-08-04T21:31:52+05:30; the day-first 04/08/2026 condition-submission dates in the portal acknowledgement generated for this upload; and the 2026-08-05 upload. A month-first reading (8 March 2026) would predate the end of the period the letter reports on.
metadata.date_semantics: August 3 is the date of the proponent's signed letter. The status sentence is in the present tense and separate from the sentence naming the December 2025 to March 2026 compliance period, so it is read as status at the letter date, as with the May 27 Thane cover letter. The proponent's condition submissions in the portal acknowledgement for this upload are dated 04/08/2026 and also describe current on-site arrangements in the present tense. PARIVESH records the upload at 2026-08-05T04:32:59.374Z, when the statement became public. Neither date is an inspection day; October retrieval does not refresh the observation.
metadata.authority_basis: Statutory six-monthly EC compliance submission (EIA Notification 2006; EC general condition C.IV) by the proponent, addressed to the Secretary, SEIAA, copied to MPCB's member secretary and Navi Mumbai regional officer, and published on the national PARIVESH portal with status IRO_FORWARD. The selected statement is the proponent's own report of the named EC project's construction phase.
metadata.physical_status_scope: Broad under_construction for the EC project only. 'Construction phase' is not normalized to any finer stage; no building count, completion percentage, commencement certificate, capacity, energization or operation is inferred.
metadata.predecessor_contrast: SEIAA's 27 November 2025 EC letter (PDF page 5, item 20) records that no construction had started after the earlier 2023 EC for the same plot, and the CAF describes the project as a conversion of a jewellery-park EC under which no construction was done. The PARIVESH listing's commencement_date (2025-11-26T18:30:00Z, i.e. 27 November 2025 IST) equals the EC grant date and is not selected as a construction-start date.
metadata.successor_review: SEIAA granted the EC on 2025-11-27. As recaptured on 2026-10-09 the proposal remains EC Granted and the compliance listing still holds only this report. Bounded searches of PARIVESH records and English-language reporting on Raiden Infotech, Turbhe/Juinagar and Google's Navi Mumbai plans found no opening, completion, withdrawal, cancellation, closure direction or stop-work order for this plot through August 20; 2026 Google India construction coverage concerns the separate Visakhapatnam project. The 2022-23 reports of Raiden leasing an eight-storey building from Amanthin Info Parks concern Plot D-31 & D-32, TTC Industrial Area (EC23B038MH169990, 39,980 m2), whose own compliance report places its site point about 0.87 km north of this plot; it is a different plot and project, not a successor. Search terms naming any company describe search scope only; no owner, operator, tenant or affiliate role is selected. Not an exhaustive permit, MPCB consent, court or inspection audit.
metadata.alternative_reading_risk: The letter also names the December 2025 to March 2026 compliance period. The status sentence is read as of the letter date because it is a separate present-tense sentence in a signed letter dated 3 August 2026. If it were instead read as describing the nominal period, no in-window observation would remain and the candidate would revert to hold, as with Digital Edge BOM and ESR MU1, whose status text sits inside report bodies labelled October 2025 to March 2026 and is transmitted by status-free letters.
metadata.confidence_note: Lifecycle confidence is set to 0.9, below the Thane 0.95, because the statement is a single generic sentence with no works detail and carries the period-reading risk above.
